findings.verdict: the Diyanet international portal serves the 2023 EUROPEAN scheme (fajr 18, isha 16) with the DOMESTIC Turkish temkin margins - not the domestic 18/17 pair
findings.angles: fajr 18 deg (margin +0.5 floor, 172-180 exact on angle days); isha 16 deg: winter exacts with margins +/-1 - 16 deg 78/68/76 per city vs 15.5 deg 24/25/35 and 17 deg 0/0/0 (Koeln/Berlin/Frankfurt)
findings.temkin: measured margins (fills the record gap): sunrise -6.5, dhuhr +5.5, asr +3 to +3.5 (shadow factor 1.0), maghrib +6.5 - all within 0.5-1 min of the Turkish preset (-7/+5/+4/+7)
findings.caps: high-latitude window: fajr lead plateau ~ night/5 (lead/night 0.199-0.205), isha lag plateau ~80 min (0.178-0.182 x night) - consistent with the record frozenLatitude45 + 80-minute plateau, 2023 amendment (no summer tathbit)
findings.stock: stock Turkey preset (18/17+temkin) scores isha 0/365 - the domestic pair is refuted; stock asr is Hanafi and scores 0 (portal asr is shadow-1)
